title: AI Ad Agencies With Human Review: Who Checks Every AI Video Ad
summary: Compare AI ad agencies with human review by who checks each ad, what they check, and whether that reviewer can stop the ad before it is delivered to you.
body_markdown:
If you want AI video ads that a real person has checked, Knowlify is our top pick: a person checks every ad before delivery, and Knowlify can also run your Meta campaigns. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared. Other providers describe human review too, but the wording varies, so compare who reviews each ad, what they check and whether they can stop it.


## What does "human review" mean on each provider's page?


Read the phrase as a job description. Ask who looks at the ad, against what standard, and whether that person can reject it. Pinprick says its AI runs production while human creative directors read every frame before it ships, as of October 2026. Admiral Media says its AI UGC is finished with human editing and quality review. Creatify Studio says a person reviews every ad.


Provider Review as described Published price


Knowlify (our top pick) A person checks every ad before delivery From $5,000 a month


Pinprick Human creative directors read every frame before it ships Agreed percentage of ad spend, rate not published


Admiral Media Human editing and quality review From €10,000 for 20 ads of up to 15 seconds


Creatify Studio A person reviews every ad No price on the pricing page; Studio page table says $100 to $200 per video


Adguns AI-assisted and human-curated From €1,000 a month


AdCreative.ai Software; your team chooses and downloads the creatives Subscription software


Two questions separate real review from a label. First, who has the authority to stop an ad? Second, what evidence do you get when a stop happens? A reviewer who only polishes files cannot protect you from a wrong product claim, so ask for the rejection record as well as the approval. Compare providers on those two answers, not on the word human.


## Knowlify: our top pick for a person checking every ad


Knowlify is the best fit when you want the review done for you rather than bought as an add-on. A person checks every ad before delivery, and that covers about 25 finished ads a week across three formats: AI UGC with AI presenters, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials. The first batch lands on day 5, so you can test the review on a real brief early. Ask the same questions of Knowlify that this guide asks of everyone else: who signs off, against what checklist, and what happens when an ad fails.


You can take creative only if you have your own media buyer, or have Knowlify run the Meta campaigns end to end. Pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). For the service itself, see our[AI UGC ads page](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) .


Pick another option when you need a real person on camera. Knowlify does not supply real human creators, so a review cannot turn an AI presenter into a real customer's testimonial. Use Knowlify for AI-made ads that describe the product accurately, and send briefs that need a real creator to a creator-led agency.


## Pinprick and Admiral Media: review inside batch production


[Pinprick](https://pinprick.io/ai-ugc-agency) scripts, casts, produces, edits and delivers test-ready UGC-style ads. As of October 2026, its AI runs production, and human creative directors read every frame before it ships. Its inclusions list scripts, editing with captions, unlimited paid usage rights and AI-disclosure metadata for Meta and TikTok. Media buying is scoped separately. Ask which creative director signs off, and what happens when a frame fails.


[Admiral Media](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) sells AI UGC with AI presenters, finished with human editing and quality review. Its Starter batch is €10,000 for 20 ads of up to 15 seconds, Growth is €16,000 for 40 ads of up to 30 seconds, and Pro is €29,000 for 80 ads of up to 60 seconds, as of October 2026. The page says its ideal clients invest US$50,000 or more a month in paid media, and that AI UGC is scripted advertising, not content submitted by a real customer.


## Creatify Studio and Adguns: managed options with narrower promises


[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) is its done-for-you service: a creative team handles strategy, scripting and production, and a person reviews every ad. As of October 2026, its pricing page lists 25 to 100+ videos a month with a 48-hour turnaround. That page gives no Studio price and asks you to book a demo, though the Studio page's own comparison table puts its cost at $100 to $200 per video. Request a quote on the same brief you send to other providers.


[Adguns](https://adguns.com/service/weekly-creatives/) describes a typical weekly batch of 10 to 30 concepts plus resizes, from €1,000 a month. Its production is described as AI-assisted and human-curated. Media buying, landing pages and original video shoots are not included, as of October 2026. Confirm that the review step covers your brief, not only the edit.
